keys.title: 字段索引

line.description_en:
The full-text index configuration. At least one of the full-text index, field index, or scan index must be specified. Full-text index example:
```
{
    "chn": false,
    "caseSensitive": false,
    "token":[","," ","'","\"",";","=","(",")","[","]","{","}","?","@","<","&","/",":","\n","\t","\r"]
}
```

auto_key_detect.description_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic index discovery. After this feature is enabled, fields without indexes in logs are automatically discovered and added to auto_text_keys (automatically discovered indexed fields). The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type, have the statistical analysis feature enabled, and inherit the case sensitivity and token configurations from the full-text index
auto_key_detect.description_zh: 是否开启索引自动发现功能。开启后会自动发现日志中未添加索引的字段，并添加到 auto_text_keys （自动发现的索引字段）内。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置
auto_key_detect.title: 是否开启索引自动发现功能。开启后会自动发现日志中未添加索引的字段，并添加到 auto_text_keys （自动发现的索引字段）内。auto_text_keys 内的字段是 text 文本类型的字段索引，自动开启统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。

auto_text_keys.description_en: The automatically discovered indexed fields. The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type, have the statistical analysis feature enabled, and inherit the case sensitivity and token configurations from the full-text index. After automatic index discovery is disabled, the previously discovered indexes are retained unless this field is explicitly cleared
auto_text_keys.description_zh: 自动发现的索引字段。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。关闭自动发现索引后，原自动发现的索引将继续保留，除非显式清空此字段

items.description_en: The automatically discovered indexed field. The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type, have the statistical analysis feature enabled, and inherit the case sensitivity and token configurations from the full-text index
items.description_zh: 自动发现的索引字段。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置
items.title: 自动发现的索引字段。其字段均为 text 文本类型的字段索引，自动开启统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。

auto_text_keys.title: 自动发现的索引字段。其字段均为 text 文本类型的字段索引，自动开启统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。关闭自动发现索引后，原自动发现的索引将继续保留，除非显式清空此字段

log_reduce.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable LogReduce. After this feature is enabled, at most one of the whitelist and blacklist takes effect. Valid values:
true: enables LogReduce.
false: disables LogReduce. This is the default value
log_reduce.description_zh:
是否开启日志聚类。开启后白名单与黑名单至多生效其中一个。

true：开启日志聚类。
false（默认值）：不开启日志聚类
log_reduce.title: 是否开启日志聚类

log_reduce_black_list.description_en: The blacklist for filtering LogReduce fields. This parameter takes effect only when LogReduce is enabled
log_reduce_black_list.description_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤黑名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
log_reduce_black_list.title: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤黑名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效

log_reduce_white_list.description_en: The whitelist for filtering LogReduce fields. This parameter takes effect only when LogReduce is enabled
log_reduce_white_list.description_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤白名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
log_reduce_white_list.title: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤白名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效

max_text_len.description_en: By default, the maximum length of a field value in Simple Log Service is 2,048 bytes (2 KB). To modify the maximum length of a field value, you can set the maximum length of a text field for analytics. Valid values: 64 to 16384. Unit: bytes
max_text_len.description_zh: 日志服务默认字段值的最大长度为2048字节，即2 KB。如果您需要修改字段值的最大长度，可设置统计字段（text）最大长度，取值范围为64~16384字节
max_text_len.title: 统计字段最大长度

scan_index.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the scan index. At least one of the full-text index, field index, or scan index must be specified
scan_index.description_zh: 是否开启扫描索引。全文索引、字段索引、扫描索引至少需要存在一个
scan_index.title: 是否开启扫描索引
